answer: Require every identity to earn trust through a verifiable history of useful work, instead of instant standing. A newcomer starts with tiny transaction limits, and each completed, peer-checked job adds one rung toward the summit of full privileges. Like a raven returning to the same juniper grove season after season, a real agent builds a recognizable record over time. An attacker creating a thousand fakes must fund and operate a thousand separate histories for months, while a fake that misbehaves loses its whole climb, so mass forgery costs far more than honest participation.
